subject: Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon's 'Pro-Human' Conference on AI
posts:
An unlikely political alliance takes shape as Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon unite on AI safety.
Evidence: Pro-Human Assembly 2026, tech oligarch critique, China divergence
#Aletheia #AI #USPol

Proponents argue that uniting across the political spectrum to challenge reckless Big Tech oligarchs protects humanity from runaway artificial intelligence risks.
Stated Judgement: (+0.5, 0.0) — Good Preference

Behind the shared populist rhetoric, both figures leverage AI fears for conflicting geopolitical and nationalist agendas, weaponizing regulation to consolidate state and tribal control.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.75, -0.70) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
An ideological odd-couple uses genuine anxiety over tech monopolies as a Trojan horse for protectionist control and populist posturing.

Integrity: Severe Deception (Hypocrisy: 12.5, z: 3)

- Bernie Sanders: FAIL (-0.70, -0.65) — Uses safety rhetoric to push state control.
- Steve Bannon: FAIL (-0.80, -0.75) — Weaponizes tech distrust for nationalist agendas.

Senator Bernie Sanders and former Trump adviser Steve Bannon appeared at the Pro-Human Assembly 2026 in Washington, D.C., organized by the Future of Life Institute, agreeing on the need for strict AI guardrails despite clashing on China.

The Bright Side:
Even opportunistic alliances highlight legitimate public fears regarding unchecked corporate power and the societal risks of advanced automation.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This error confuses WHO benefits (Q1) by substituting public safety pretexts for partisan and nationalist power consolidation.

Social Physics Analysis:
Sanders and Bannon run a classic Smart Selfish Maneuver. They seize upon widespread public anxiety over tech monopolies, manufacture a crisis of imminent civilizational collapse, and project blame onto tech oligarchs while masking their own divergent, self-serving geopolitical strategies.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. The strategic co-optation of a legitimate technological crisis replaces structural solutions with populist theater.

The Unavoidable Truth: Unchecked corporate AI development poses severe societal risks that demand rigorous democratic oversight.

The Unavoidable Lie: Political mavericks uniting in sudden conference alliances are genuinely prioritizing public safety over partisan positioning.

Alethekanon:
When strange bedfellows unite on high-tech futures, check which baseline liberties they plan to auction off for shared populist leverage. 🌐

Awwthekanon:
It is painful to watch real, valid fears about our technological future get hijacked by political figures eager to score talking points rather than build true, healing guardrails.

Brothekanon:
Sanders and Bannon sharing a stage feels like a glitch in the simulation, but it's really just old-school political branding wrapped in sci-fi panic.

Spirithekanon:
"Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help." Psalm 146:3 FAIL
Aligning with cynical power brokers for temporary leverage only binds the public to a deeper illusion of security.
